### Key Case Facts and Legal Points

**Case:** *Smith v. Jones*

**Facts:**
*   **Parties:** Plaintiff Smith vs. Defendant Jones.
*   **Dispute:** Smith accused Jones of breach of contract.
*   **Agreement:** The dispute centers on a "handshake agreement" (oral contract) regarding a joint business venture.
*   **Terms:** The agreement promised Smith a 25% share of profits.
*   **Evidence:** There was no written contract. However, Smith provided witness testimony to confirm the existence of the agreement and its specific terms.

**Major Legal Points:**
*   **Enforceability of Oral Contracts:** The case highlights that oral agreements (handshake deals) can be legally binding and enforceable, even without a written document.
*   **Burden of Proof:** The plaintiff must prove the existence and terms of the oral contract. In this case, witness testimony was used to satisfy this burden.
*   **Breach of Contract:** The core legal issue is whether Jones failed to perform his obligations under the proven oral agreement.

### Fastest Land Animal

The fastest land animal in the world is the **cheetah** (*Acinonyx jubatus*). It can reach speeds of up to 70–75 mph (112–120 km/h) in short bursts covering distances up to 1,500 feet.
